name: mnote_create_notebook
description: Create a new notebook (a top-level space, e.g. 'Work'). `name` is the label; `slug` is an optional URL-safe id (lowercase, digits, dashes) derived from name if omitted. Slugs are unique per account (409 if taken). Requires the notes:write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the created notebook including its slug.

slug.description: Optional URL-safe id; derived from name if omitted.
